reviews.author: Allysen Fitzpatrick
reviews.text: If I could give more than five stars I would! We have been so pleased with the communication and openness of cicc and Shawna. They made what seemed like a super complicated endeavor, to turn our carport into livable space, seem so flawless. The attention to detail, the quality of products, the fact that they use other small businesses in town where they can.... just simply the best. God hand picked them for our project and I feel like we have life long friends because of it. We will forever be grateful for them!!!

reviews.author: Wynn Smith
reviews.text:
We had a drainage issue at our house and honestly couldn’t be happier with how Ferrentino Construction handled it! They were quick to get out, figured out what needed to be done, and got the work finished so quickly. After the drainage issue was fixed they also did a sidewalk with pavers and the finished product looks GREAT!

It’s so nice to find a company that shows up, does quality work, and genuinely takes pride in what they do. Also, they were considerably cheaper than other quotes I received. We’re really happy with the results and would absolutely recommend Ferrentino Construction to anyone needing work done. Thank you guys for making what could have been a stressful project so easy! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
